pr_title: Add tests for null response scenarios to RDG

issue_context.title: Add test scenarios for nullable return types in route handlers for RDG
issue_context.body:
Validate scenarios where return types in user's route handlers might be marked as nullable:

- `ValueTask<T>?`/`Task<T>?`
- `T?`
comments:
Found a bug:

```csharp
Todo? GetMaybeTodo(int id) => id == 0 ? null : new Todo(1, "foo");
app.MapGet("/", GetMaybeTodo);
```

Produces:

```
/Users/captainsafia/repos/aspnetcore/src/Http/samples/MinimalSample/Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Generators/Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Generators.RequestDelegateGenerator/GeneratedRouteBuilderExtensions.g.cs(107,100): error CS8639: The typeof operator cannot be used on a nullable reference type [/Users/captainsafia/repos/aspnetcore/src/Http/samples/MinimalSample/MinimalSample.csproj]
```

Because of:

```csharp
var jsonTypeInfo =  (JsonTypeInfo<global::Todo?>)serializerOptions.GetTypeInfo(typeof(global::Todo?));
```

Thanks for contacting us.

We're moving this issue to the `.NET 8 Planning` milestone for future evaluation / consideration. We would like to keep this around to collect more feedback, which can help us with prioritizing this work. We will re-evaluate this issue, during our next planning meeting(s). 
If we later determine, that the issue has no community involvement, or it's very rare and low-impact issue, we will close it - so that the team can focus on more important and high impact issues.
To learn more about what to expect next and how this issue will be handled you can read more about our triage process [here](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/docs/TriageProcess.md).

review_comments: This feels odd to explicitly protect against, but you've already done the work 🤷‍♂️

RDF has similar checks you can see [here](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/Http/Http.Extensions/src/RequestDelegateFactory.cs#L2277).

Admittedly, this is an extremely defensive check against people writing endpoints like:

```
app.MapGet("/", (int id) => id == 0 ? SomeThingThatReturnsAValueTaskOfT() : SomethingThatReturnsNull);
```
